I am a PhD student at the [German Sport University Cologne](https://www.dshs-koeln.de/en/). My research focusses on reproducibility, research methodology, and applied statistics, mainly in the field of sports and exercise science. 

My current projects include an investigation of the reproducibility of published sports science research, a review of statistical practices in meta-analyses in sport science, and the development of a tool to extract data from articles for research synthesis. I have worked as a data analyst on different projects in the fields of sports performance analysis and applied physiology.

I believe that more transparency and rigor can lead to more trustworthy and impactful research. Therefore, I commit to open science practices, such as preregistration and data sharing, and support the mission of [STORK](https://www.storkinesiology.org/). As part of my research, I have developed open-source software tools for the reproducible analysis of exercise-related data. I also teach data science and statistics to students in the field of sport and exercise science.
